name: Lots Wife
overview: The account of Lot's wife, as recorded in Genesis 19, highlights the consequences of disobedience to God's direct command. When Lot and his family were instructed to flee Sodom without looking back, Lot's wife looked behind her and was turned into a pillar of salt, illustrating the seriousness of trusting God's word and the peril of longing for a sinful past. This narrative underscores the importance of obedience and faith in God's protection amid judgment, as seen in Lot's role in sheltering the angels and the divine warning to escape without delay.
